gumroad.technical_path_if_opened: Notably lower friction than Etsy: a personal access token generated directly in the seller's own account settings (no OAuth redirect/PKCE flow needed for self-use), then a REST API to create/update/publish a product and attach a file. Not built or tested.

If an account already exists and is payout-ready, this is a genuinely low-cost PARALLEL addition to Etsy (same product ZIP, minimal incremental setup) -- but expected demand is low: Gumroad's Discover feature favors listings with existing sales/reviews, so a brand-new zero-review listing gets little organic traffic, similar to the current zero-traffic Stripe store. Will not build integration code before an account is confirmed to exist.

creem.evidence: No account/approval/payout evidence anywhere in this repo. Only prior mention (2026-08-25) was that it had no MCP connector in the sandbox -- never pursued further.
creem.assessment: Even if an account exists and is approved, Creem is payment/billing infrastructure (Merchant-of-Record checkout) -- the same functional role Stripe already fills live, not a marketplace with its own buyer-search discovery. No differentiator over the already-working Stripe rail has been identified. Will NOT build a Creem integration without a specific identified advantage -- would be redundant payment infrastructure with no evidence of added distribution value. Lowest-priority item in this inventory; status confirmation requested for completeness only.

A browser/Computer-Use path was investigated first (2026-09-01T13:30 UTC) and confirmed not viable: no browser-driving tool is exposed to this session, sandbox egress to www.etsy.com is blocked at the network policy level (confirmed live), and no Etsy credentials/session exist anywhere accessible to the AI. Spec verified 2026-09-01T14:00 UTC against redirect_uri HTTPS requirement, keystring-vs-shared-secret handling, minimum OAuth scope (trimmed to listings_w/listings_r/shops_r), Seller App access level, refresh-token rotation (~90 days), and digital-listing required fields -- 5 fixed/clarified, 1 (exact createDraftListing field schema) honestly still unverified pending a live run. See ops/ETSY_API_SETUP.md for the full investigation and spec verification.
